positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (50.9): 3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 134 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kovan MRT about 550 m, Serangoon MRT about 1,000 m; closer than 234 of 462 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Paya Lebar Methodist Girls' School (Primary) about 940 m; more than 59 of 462 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 420 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre about 680 m; nearest park Surin Ave Neighbourhood Park about 320 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Serangoon North MRT about 1,530 m (LTA target 2030) and Defu MRT about 1,970 m (LTA target 2030), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 570 m; Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 1,750 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 147 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 833 resales (958 purchases); new sales were 13% of these purchases. Subsales (7) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 833 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 341 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 833 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 900 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.4%). Planning-area private resales −7.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
